cardOverview.overviewText: The all-new American Express® Platinum Corporate Card brings you benefits made greater, now with Metal. Elevate your business and experience when you travel for business and earn accelerated reward on every spend you make. Experience the powerful backing of Amex as you step into the world of Platinum.

eligibility:
Enjoy access to The Centurion® Lounges* and Escape Lounges – The Centurion® Studio Partner, Lufthansa lounges, and Delta Sky Club®
Get a membership to the highest tier of Priority PassTM (valued at US $429) and access to over 1,200 airport lounges across the globe.
Access the Centurion Lounge at Terminal 3, IGI Airport Delhi, and at Terminal 2, CSI Airport Mumbai along with over 30 domestic airport partner lounges across key cities in India.
